name: Crisp Isle of Corona Fried Shrimp with Pea Purée (Lantern Night)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Magic · Rapunzel's Royal Table (Lantern Night)
whyItWorks: Battered and deep-fried shrimp served with a lemon-remoulade tartar sauce; frying oil and lemon juice make this risky.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for grilled or poached shrimp cocktail with plain cocktail sauce (no lemon) instead of the deep-fried Corona shrimp.
